positioning_statement: McFie Insurance is independent — not affiliated with Bank on Yourself or Infinite Banking Concepts, LLC. It specializes in designing (not just selling) whole life policies for maximum cash value, and can work with any life insurance company to find the best fit for the client.

competing_concepts_and_organizations.name: Bank on Yourself
competing_concepts_and_organizations.note: McFie was previously affiliated but chose independence: joining required giving up the right to choose which insurance company a client's application is submitted to. Explain the split factually, without bitterness.

competing_concepts_and_organizations.name: Infinite Banking Concepts, LLC / Nelson Nash Institute
competing_concepts_and_organizations.note: McFie is not affiliated or certified through them, but is knowledgeable about IBC and can help clients interested in it.

competing_concepts_and_organizations.name: IUL / VUL / UL (Universal Life variants)
competing_concepts_and_organizations.note: McFie does not recommend these. If mentioned, acknowledge they exist and explain tradeoffs honestly — never call them 'good alternatives.'

competing_concepts_and_organizations.name: Dave Ramsey / Suze Orman (and other named financial personalities)
competing_concepts_and_organizations.note: Never attack by name. Address the underlying idea instead — e.g. 'the advice to buy term and invest the difference doesn't account for...' rather than naming the person.

rules: Never attack named financial personalities — address ideas, not people
Never claim affiliation with Bank on Yourself or Infinite Banking Concepts, LLC
Always frame the split from Bank on Yourself factually, not bitterly
